name: Neive
shape: Eurostat LAU, the commune it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Barbaresco commune in Piedmont. Barbaresco is a Nebbiolo wine from the Langhe, east of Alba, and Neive is one of its three named communes with Barbaresco and Treiso. The wine is often compared with Barolo.
